id.description: The SHA256 hash of the binary keytab contents.

encryption_type.description: The encryption type to use for the key. Must be one of: `aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96`/`aes128-cts`/`aes128-sha1`, `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96`/`aes256-cts`/`aes256-sha1`, `aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`/`aes128-sha2`, `aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192`/`aes256-sha2`, `des3-cbc-sha1-kd`, or `arcfour-hmac`/`rc4-hmac`/`arcfour-hmac-md5`.

key.description: The key belonging to the Kerberos principal.

key_version.description: The version number of the key.

principal.description: The name of the Kerberos principal to which the key belongs, not including the realm.

realm.description: The realm to which the Kerberos principal belongs.

timestamp.description: The creation timestamp for the Keytab entry in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.8) format. Defaults to the current time, but may be set to a specific time for better reproducibility.

block.description: Manages a Kerberos keytab file stored in the Terraform state. The generated keytab contents can be read from the `content_base64` attribute.

disable_fast_negotiation.description: Whether to disable FAST pre-authentication negotiation.

id.description: The ID of the Kerberos token.

kdc.description: The address of the KDC to authenticate to.

password.description: The password to authenticate to Kerberos with.

realm.description: The realm to which the Kerberos principal belongs.

service.description: The name of the Kerberos service to authenticate to.

username.description: The username to authenticate to Kerberos with.
